title: Misgendering as Breakdown in Human-Machine Communication: How AI Companion Chatbot Users Experience and Repair Misgendering
reasoning: The paper focuses on an empirical qualitative study of misgendering and gender bias (including cisnormativity and heteronormativity) in LLM-based AI companion chatbots. It does not focus on evaluating or benchmarking moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious topics.
